functions.name: search_code_hits
functions.description: Query-qualified code search hit observations. Grain combines the exact query with canonical returned identity; ordering and search-mode selectors define the invocation population. Result position is response order across pages, not durable identity. Total count and incomplete_results are exposed per returned hit and are not additive facts. A partial response, changed count, or 1000-result API cap prevents successful completion. Optional text-match fields remain typed when returned; this route does not request highlighted-media enrichment. Search covers only indexed files smaller than 384 KB on default branches and requires authentication; it is not a repository contents inventory.

metrics.name: search_code_hit_count
metrics.comment: Query-qualified code hits in one complete API response population, not a count of all GitHub code.

search_code_hit_max_score.comment: Maximum upstream relevance score in this selected query population; scores are not additive and are not comparable across different query kinds or invocations.

functions.name: search_issue_hits

Grain combines the exact query with canonical returned identity; ordering and search-mode selectors define the invocation population. Result position is response order across pages, not durable identity. Total count and incomplete_results are exposed per returned hit and are not additive facts.
